title: Mexican Corn Salad
description: Mexican Corn Salad is a vibrant dish made with charred sweet corn, creamy mayonnaise and Mexican crema, Cotija cheese, lime, and aromatic spices. Finished with fresh cilantro, it delivers a perfect balance of smoky, tangy, and creamy flavors.

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Fresh corn cobs – 4 (or 3 cups corn kernels)
Red chili (or jalapeño) – 1 small, finely chopped
Mexican crema or sour cream – ¼ cup
Cotija cheese (or Feta) – ½ cup, finely crumbled
Ground cumin – ½ tsp, lightly toasted
Freshly cracked black pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Micro cilantro or baby coriander leaves

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Corn
steps: Grill the corn cobs over an open flame or hot grill pan for 8–10 minutes until lightly charred.
Allow to cool slightly, then cut the kernels from the cobs.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Base
steps: Heat the butter and olive oil in a sauté pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and shallot and cook until fragrant without browning.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Build the Salad
steps: Add the grilled corn kernels to the pan.
Season with smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly.
Whisk together the mayonnaise, Mexican crema, lime juice, and lime zest.
Fold the warm corn mixture into the dressing along with half of the Cotija cheese.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Adjust the Seasoning
steps: Taste the salad and adjust with extra lime juice, salt, pepper, or chili if required.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating
steps: Arrange the salad neatly on a serving plate using a ring mold if desired.
Top with the remaining Cotija cheese.
Finish with a light dusting of smoked paprika or chili powder and serve with a charred lime wedge.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve warm as a starter or side dish.
Pair with grilled chicken, prawns, or seared scallops.
Enjoy with grilled meats or as part of a continental buffet.

chefTips: Grill the corn until lightly charred for the best smoky flavor.
Serve warm rather than chilled to enhance the sweetness of the corn.
Use freshly squeezed lime juice for a brighter flavor.
Add crispy tortilla strips or puffed quinoa for extra texture.
Finish with finely grated Cotija cheese for an elegant presentation.
